name: Version 0.9.3
body:
## Changelog

- Support OMM (Opacity Micromaps) for DirectX Raytracing (DXR) through NVAPI. This requires [VKD3D-Proton 3.1](https://github.com/HansKristian-Work/vkd3d-proton/releases/tag/v3.1) or newer and the VK_KHR_opacity_micromap extension, available in NVIDIA driver R615 or newer.
- Add an alternative Reflex implementation for Vulkan titles using the VK_NV_low_latency revision 2 extension, available in NVIDIA driver R615 and newer. This alternative implementation doesn't require a Vulkan layer anymore and thus makes the DXVK-NVAPI Vulkan layer obsolete.
- Support new driver settings from NVAPI R610 headers:
  - `NGX_DLSS_NR_OVERRIDE`
  - `NGX_DLSS_NR_OVERRIDE_RENDER_PRESET_SELECTION`
  - `NGX_DLSS_NR_SL_OVERRIDE`
- Support new driver settings from NVAPI R615 headers:
  - `SL_DLSS_OVERRIDE`
- Store NVAPI wrappers for device, command list and command queue in D3D12 private data instead of in a cache map. This should prevent crashes with several titles i.c.w. modding tools.
- Improve reporting for available/free VRAM, the behavior is now closer to NVAPI on Windows.
- Fix a potential race condition during initialization. This fixes a crash in Elite Dangerous when using the EDHM mod.
- Allow Sound Voltex to retrieve output refresh rate info by implementing `NvAPI_DISP_GetDisplayConfig`.
- Remove Pascal spoofing for War Thunder.  This work around is no longer needed. DLSS i.c.w. D3D11 is functional with that title now.
- Add a workaround for the NVIDIA RTX Path Tracing Sample (https://github.com/NVIDIA-RTX/RTXPT) for allowing it to use NVAPI shader extensions without setting `DXVK_NVAPI_D3D12_NV_SHADER_EXTN=1`.
- Support compilation for ARM64. The release artifact includes an ARM64 build.

## Header updates

- Update NVAPI headers to R615.
- Update NVML headers to R615.
- Update Vulkan headers to 1.4.357.
- Update DirectX headers to 1.721.0.
- Update vkroots headers to g20733b9.

## Pre-built artifact

Please validate the digest of a downloaded asset with the artifacts on the GitHub CI run summary and this release page. 

Digest check: `sha256sum dxvk-nvapi-v0.9.3.tar.gz`
GitHub CI Run: [https://github.com/jp7677/dxvk-nvapi/actions/runs/41096497992](https://github.com/jp7677/dxvk-nvapi/actions/runs/41096497992)
